_README: Spoils of war for tools/foundry-bridge.py apply — the live world mirror after the Skittering Grove arc
tools/sheets-suite.py applies it on each pass while the mirror's export is not newer than appliesTo.exportedAtOrBefore
(a later export already carries the table's version of these items); items are matched by id, so re-applying is a no-op.
XP is not set here: tools/promote-player-sheets.py pins every player sheet to the XP ledger (const XP_SUMMARY in index.html).
Spoils already on the exported sheets (Markop's motorbike, Remi's and Archie's grove kit) are not repeated;
the two items below are the ones the record files and the sheets lacked.

description.value:
A sphere that hums, picked up by Eager at the end of the grove floor fight on 1 Aethel, 1040 BF; the record says it was powered during the giant battle by Archie Miser's electric magic. The archive has no earlier sighting and files the claim as stated.

Mechanics not yet established at the table. Carried out of the Skittering Grove by Eager, on two hit points. Technology file: tech_grove_electric_sphere.

source.custom: Waluipedia campaign — The Way I Started It

unidentified.description: A humming sphere out of the Skittering Grove.

waluipedia.note: spoil of the grove floor fight; the thing hums and nothing else about it is established

Permanent Injury Table, row 59 — Sprained Thumb (Minor injury). Rolled on 1 Aethel, 1040 BF after falling to zero on the grove floor and coming back up.

You cannot fight with two weapons, and attack rolls with a versatile weapon used two-handed are made at disadvantage.

Cure: rest — one week. Duration: one week. Remove this feature when the week is up.
